registry_info.name: progression_debug
registry_info.description: Debug and scaffold artifacts for testing the soft-stage progression system — EcosystemManager, HazardManager, CatalystCapabilityManager.

soft_stage_dashboard.name: Soft Stage Dashboard
soft_stage_dashboard.description: Wall-mounted read-only panel showing live state from EcosystemManager, HazardManager, and CatalystCapabilityManager. Three-column layout with allow flags, hazard types and personalities, capacity level and hand verbs. Rolling signal log at the bottom captures all manager events with timestamps.

progression_driver.name: Progression Driver
progression_driver.description: Interactive VR control panel to advance through sequences, befriend hazards, and reset progression on all three managers. Slider selects sequence, buttons trigger force_advance_to or reset_progression. Dynamically generates befriend buttons for all hazard types found in soft_stages.json.
